# Base64 Codec API

[![MCP Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-server-blue)](https://base64-codec.api.klymax402.com/mcp)
[![x402](https://img.shields.io/badge/payments-x402-6E56CF)](https://x402.org)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

Encode text to base64 or decode base64 to text. Supports standard and URL-safe variants with metadata. Pay-per-call via [x402](https://x402.org) (USDC on Base L2) -- no API key, no signup, no rate-limit wall.

Part of the [klymax402](https://klymax402.com) marketplace -- 100 x402 micropayment APIs for AI agents, one wallet, USDC on Base.

## Quickstart -- MCP

Add to your MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ElizaOS, etc.):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "base64-codec": {
      "url": "https://base64-codec.api.klymax402.com/mcp"
    }

}
```

## Quickstart -- HTTP (x402)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://base64-codec.api.klymax402.com/api/encode" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"data":"..."}'
# -> 402 Payment Required, with an x402 payment challenge in the response body
```

Any x402-aware client ([`@x402/fetch`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@x402/fetch), [`x402-agent-tools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/x402-agent-tools), ATXP) handles the 402 -> sign -> retry cycle automatically.

### `utility_encode_base64`

Use this when you need to encode text to base64 or decode base64 back to plaintext. Returns the result string with encoding metadata.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | string | yes | The data to encode or decode |
| `action` | string | no | Action: 'encode' or 'decode' (default: encode) |

Example response:

```json
{"result":"SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=","action":"encode","inputLength":11,"outputLength":16,"urlSafe":false}
```

**When to use**: embedding binary data in JSON, preparing email attachments (MIME), or decoding base64 tokens from APIs. Use this BEFORE sending data through channels that only support ASCII.

**Not for**: hashing (use `crypto_generate_hash`), JWT decoding (use `security_decode_jwt`), URL slug creation (use `text_generate_slug`).
